scores.rationale: Mixed box of 1950s-60s footy and sport magazines in fair condition; a few desirable covers but mostly common, realistic box value about $50-80.
Large cast iron boiler with worn Kenrick mark; common, bulky and rusty, realistic value about $30-70.
Unmarked 3-legged cast iron camp oven, Falkirk attribution unproven; large size helps, realistic $60-110.
Creality Ender-3 printer complete but untested; used market about $80-140 discounted for risk.
21 Eaglemoss/Fabbri Bond cars in cases without magazines; individually $10-25 each, lot likely $150-300.
Tarnished brass sprayer plus used Bosch Isio shears; both low value, about $30-60 together.
Mostly common crown-seal and later bottles, a few Tasmanian embossed ones; dirty, realistic $50-90.
Eight faded and rusty Tas plates, some pairs and incomplete; local collector interest, realistic $60-100.
Spong wall-mounted cast iron coffee mill, good and complete; common English kitchenalia, realistic $50-90.
Two toolboxes of generic, rusty hand tools; low value, about $30-50.
